The markdown carries no page markers (only occasional stray page numbers and the authors' draft footer). Printed page numbers therefore survive only where the table of contents supplies them, i.e. at section granularity. Sub-section citations use markdown anchors (file + line) instead of page numbers.

34 heading occurrences repeat an earlier identical heading. The extraction interleaves the printed running header into the body text, so a naive heading scan counts a section more than once. Affected (worst first): 2.3 x4; 2.7 x4; 3.8 x4; 8.3 x4; 11.4 x3.
